items.title: 68516_Gene Ramey oral history interview
items.q: Yeah, he would travel as an arranger and kind of help with the transportation

ctx.x: But did he travel with you as an arranger then?

Yeah, he would travel as an arranger and kind of help with the transportation and sometimes on the door and like that. But McShean had -- we had made an agreement with Johnny -- in fact, they wanted to put it in writing and I should have got them to do it then, that I was supposed
to take over the band and it would still be Jay McShann and his band, featuring Walter Brown, under the direction of Gene Ramey.
